Professional Summary
Azure DevOps Engineer currently at Pixelwave Studios with hands-on experience deploying and managing cloud-native workloads on Microsoft Azure. Azure, Terraform, Kubernetes, Azure DevOps, Ansible, Bicep, Agile, Jira, Git

- Built Git-based CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps to automate container image builds and deployments to Kubernetes, improving deployment frequency and enabling zero-downtime rollouts.
- Automated configuration management for application nodes using Ansible playbooks and integrated releases with Jira for tracking, resulting in clearer release traceability and fewer configuration drift incidents.
- Collaborated with developers and SREs in Agile ceremonies to iterate on infra-as-code modules and Helm charts for Kubernetes, streamlining incident response and rollback procedures.
